messages:
jules-marketing: quick heads up — seeing a small but steady uptick in unassigned inbound leads during EMEA mornings (~3% last 2 days). looks like enrichment timeouts cause leads to skip round-robin and land in unclaimed queue. :eyes:

devin-salesops: curious — any errors from HubSpot? can you paste a sample log?

jules-marketing: yep, pasted one below from the enrichment worker logs:
```
2026-03-21T07:12:03Z ERROR enrichment timeout id=8f3a8c hubspot-call failed after 4000ms
2026-03-21T07:12:03Z WARN fallback -> mark as "enrichment_failed" and route to unassigned
```

ana-growth: (typo — meant ana-growth) i think the TTL was set lower during last-week perf tweak. prod shows 4s which is tight for HS enrichment during EMEA peak.

devin-salesops: OK — options: 1) bump enrichment TTL to 10s globally, 2) implement graceful fallback: minimal enrichment (email+company) then proceed to RR, or 3) heartbeat + requeue owner claim for 30s.

sam-engineering: prefer minimal fallback + canary TTL bump. we can roll a 10% canary that changes workflow to: try-enrich(4s) -> on timeout do-minimal-enrich -> RR. that keeps latency for most users but fixes the skip.

mike-sdr: sounds good. one ask — when fallback happens, add tag "fallback_enrich" so SDRs know contact context.

ana-growth: agreed. also would like metrics: % routed via fallback, avg claim time, SLA misses. can we emit a custom event to datadog?

sam-engineering: yes. i’ll add metric names: inbound.enrich.fallback.count, inbound.claim.latency.hist, inbound.sla.missed.count.

devin-salesops: for rollout plan: canary at 10% for 2 hours, monitor fallback_rate and claim_latency. if fallback_rate > 1% or sla_missed spikes -> rollback. if stable -> 100% in 24h.

jules-marketing: who owns the canary patch and playbook? also create an ops runbook snippet for SDRs to escalate weird leads.

sam-engineering: i’ll own the patch + datadog dashboards. devin, can you own canary gating + Sales Ops comms?

devin-salesops: yep, i’ll set the canary runbook and weekly slack alert. adding a temporary HubSpot workflow change: if enrichment_failed then set owner to "fallback-queue" with tag fallback_enrich. hubspot-bot: please schedule that change at 10:05 UTC for canary.

hubspot-bot: scheduled workflow update: enrichment-fallback -> target=fallback-queue at 2026-03-22T10:05:00Z. triggered by devin-salesops.

mike-sdr: small UX ask — can we include enrichment failure reason in the contact record (e.g., timeout vs 404)? helps prioritization.

sam-engineering: yes, minimal payload: enrichment_reason (timeout|no_data|error).

jules-marketing: ok next steps: 1) sam deploys patch to canary (10%) 2) devin schedules hubspot workflow 3) ana prepares 1-pager for SDRs + tags 4) monitor 2h then decide. tagging/metrics are must-haves.

devin-salesops: logging the decision in the ticketing board: LINK_TO_TICKET (internal). will ping again when canary is live. :thumbsup:

analytic-check: FYI — if fallback reduces SLA misses by >50% we'll run an experiment to see long-term TTL tradeoffs.

jules-marketing: thanks team. i’ll follow up with a short postmortem-style note if we hit the issue again.

sam-engineering: deployed canary to 10% at 2026-03-22T10:06:00Z, monitoring metrics.

devin-salesops: canary live. starting 2h watch window.

mike-sdr: seeing first fallback tag on a lead — looks fine. thanks! :party-parrot:
